catalog_name: Financial calculations and numerical acceptance fixtures
numeric_encoding: Decimal amounts are strings so transport does not change financial values.
expression_notation: Expressions are mathematical descriptions. Names are fully spelled-out variable identifiers. They do not prescribe an execution language.

rounding_contract.field_precision: Every round operation uses the precision explicitly identified by the field or scenario.
rounding_contract.scale_sensitive_tie_behaviour: Scale by ten to the requested precision and round the intermediate to eight decimal places. At integer precision an exact half selects the even integer. At nonzero precision an exact half selects the next integer toward positive infinity.
rounding_contract.settlement_fraction_tie: A remainder exactly equal to half the configured fraction selects the lower multiple.
rounding_contract.scope_note: All active selectable rounding settings remain in scope even when their source labels refer to historical compatibility. Software-version migration remains excluded.
rounding_contract.implementation_choice: Exact decimal representation is proposed; expected observable outputs remain authoritative.

execution_status: Business calculations and selected test assertions were inspected. Original application execution was not performed. Additional complete accounting event scenarios in accounting-acceptance-cases.json were checked independently using exact decimal arithmetic.
